name: routexk
description: RouteXL route planner: find the best order to drive many stops (deliveries, client visits, pickups, errands) and see the stop order, total distance and drive time.

interface.longDescription:
RouteXL is a route planner for drivers with many stops: delivery drivers, couriers, sales reps, field technicians and anyone running errands. Give a starting point and the addresses you need to visit in any order; RouteXL works out the best order to drive them using real road travel times and shows it in the chat with the total distance and the time including stops.

Use it when you:
- have a list of deliveries, pickups or client visits and want the fastest order;
- need to plan today's route and come back to the start or finish at a given place;
- want to open the planned route in the RouteXL mobile app or on the RouteXL website for turn-by-turn navigation, without typing the stops again.

What you can do:
- Optimize up to 25 stops in one route, starting anywhere and ending at a chosen place, at the last stop, or back at the start.
- Use full addresses or place names; add a city if the addresses are short.

Limitations: routes are planned for driving. Addresses that cannot be found exactly are listed back so you can clarify them. Time windows, vehicle capacity and multi-driver routes are not available in ChatGPT.
capabilities: Open in RouteXL app or on web
